# New Relic
New Relic provides comprehensive observability solutions for modern software teams. Monitor, debug, and improve your entire technology stack with full-stack observability, application performance monitoring (APM), infrastructure monitoring, browser monitoring, and more.
## Homepage

- [Observability built to understand AI](https://newrelic.com/): New Relic is an AI-powered observability platform that correlates your telemetry across your entire stack, so you can isolate the root cause and reduce MTTR.
## Platform

- [New Relic Observability Platform](https://newrelic.com/platform): New Relic is an intelligent observability platform brings telemetry, operational context, AI, and business data together for better, faster decisions.
- [SRE Agent ](https://newrelic.com/platform/sre-agent): New Relic SRE Agent uses AI-driven automation to detect issues, explain incidents, and guide remediation. Reduce MTTR and improve reliability with intelligent SRE workflows.
- [AIOps and Applied Intelligence](https://newrelic.com/platform/applied-intelligence): Use AIOps to detect and manage incidents, dependencies, and anomalies across your stack. Alert teams, determine root cause, and resolve critical issues faster.
- [Cloud Cost Intelligence](https://newrelic.com/platform/cloud-cost-intelligence): Connect cloud and AI spend to service performance through real-time visibility, intelligent recommendations, and AI-powered actions. 
- [Business observability that connects technology to outcomes](https://newrelic.com/platform/pathpoint): Connect technical performance to real business outcomes so teams can prioritize what matters most to customers, revenue, and growth.
- [Value Calculator](https://newrelic.com/platform/value-calculator): Value Calculator
- [Federated Logs](https://newrelic.com/platform/federated-logs): Federated Logs for data residency: keep log data in your own cloud region and query it there, alongside APM and infrastructure telemetry. 
- [New Relic Monitoring for SAP® Solutions](https://newrelic.com/solutions/sap): New Relic Monitoring for SAP Solutions gives you a centralized view of SAP and non-SAP systems for infrastructure, application and business processes.
- [OpenTelemetry | Visualize and Analyze Data | New Relic](https://newrelic.com/solutions/opentelemetry): Visualize and analyze all your OpenTelemetry data with New Relic. We make it easy to ingest and explore all your telemetry data at pennies per gigabyte.
- [New Relic Workflow Automation](https://newrelic.com/platform/workflow-automation): Automate incident response and operational tasks with New Relic Workflow Automation. Turn observability data into intelligent, automated actions.
- [Security RX](https://newrelic.com/platform/security-rx): New Relic Security RX gives DevOps, SREs, and InfoSec unified security insights to prioritize risk and speed software development.
- [New Relic APM 360](https://newrelic.com/platform/application-monitoring): Application monitoring a set of tools and software used to monitor and optimize the performance of software applications. Detect and diagnose issues quickly.
- [Serverless Monitoring](https://newrelic.com/platform/serverless-monitoring): With New Relic Serverless, monitor, visualize, and alert on all your serverless functions in a single place. Get answers faster with complete visibility across your entire estate.
- [Transaction 360](https://newrelic.com/platform/transaction-360): Improve incident response with 360 transaction monitoring. Cut through noise with aggregated data to resolve critical issues faster.
- [New Relic eBPF](https://newrelic.com/platform/ebpf): Deploy and monitor everything easily — applications, Kubernetes, infrastructure, and networks — using New Relic eBPF's no-code instrumentation.
- [Browser Monitoring](https://newrelic.com/platform/browser-monitoring): Unlock a better user experience with browser monitoring from New Relic.  Part of our fully-integrated, AI-driven DEM solution
- [Mobile Monitoring](https://newrelic.com/platform/mobile-monitoring): Fix crashes and optimize UX across iOS, Android, and React Native with New Relic real-time mobile monitoring. 
- [Session Replay](https://newrelic.com/platform/session-replay): Optimize UX with New Relic Session Replay. Watch every tap synced with telemetry to resolve issues faster, boost engagement, and eliminate guesswork.
- [Streaming Video Intelligence](https://newrelic.com/platform/streaming-video-intelligence): Monitor and optimize video and ad streaming performance with intelligent insights into quality of experience metrics.
- [Synthetic Monitoring | Test and Improve Your Code](https://newrelic.com/platform/synthetics): Enhance user experience with synthetics. Simulate user journeys, troubleshoot faster, and collaborate with this powerful monitoring tool. Start for free!
- [Web Performance Monitoring - Observability for Websites](https://newrelic.com/platform/web-performance-monitoring): Learn how New Relic Web Performance Monitoring can help website owners monitor and improve their websites. 
## Pricing

- [Transparent Pricing - Start for Free](https://newrelic.com/pricing): Simple, transparent pricing. Only pay for what you use.
- [Request Standard Pricing](https://newrelic.com/request-pricing-standard): Get Standard pricing for small teams starting with observability. Customized, easy-to-estimate pricing, ticketed support, and SAML single sign-on.
- [Request Pro Pricing](https://newrelic.com/request-pricing-pro): Get Pro pricing for teams with more than five engineers. Includes unlimited platform users, Data Plus, and consumption-based Compute pricing.
- [Request Enterprise Pricing](https://newrelic.com/request-pricing-enterprise): Get Enterprise pricing for at-scale organizations. Includes FedRAMP and HIPAA eligibility, 24/7 support, and consumption-based Compute pricing.
- [Request Pricing](https://newrelic.com/request-pricing): Get a custom quote for New Relic's full-stack observability platform, trusted by 75,000+ businesses. Explore usage-based and Compute pricing options.
## Solutions

- [AIOps](https://newrelic.com/solutions/aiops): New Relic AIOps prevents revenue-impacting incidents through AI-powered detection, automated investigation, and proactive remediation—in one unified platform.
- [AWS Cost Optimization | New Relic](https://newrelic.com/solutions/aws/aws-cost-optimization): AWS Cost Optimization
- [New Relic best practice guide](https://newrelic.com/solutions/best-practice-guide): New Relic best practice guide.
- [DevOps Monitoring Tool](https://newrelic.com/solutions/devops): Supercharge your DevOps with AI. New Relic's intelligent observability platform uses AI to help you proactively resolve issues and reduce your mean time to resolution.
- [Digital Experience Monitoring](https://newrelic.com/solutions/digital-experience-monitoring): Digital experience monitoring (DEM) combines website performance monitoring, user behavior analytics, engagement intelligence data, real user monitoring (RUM), session replay, and synthetic monitoring.
- [Digital Transformation](https://newrelic.com/solutions/digital-transformation): New Relic Digital Transformation 
- [Enterprise Observability](https://newrelic.com/solutions/enterprise-monitoring): AI-driven for speed and power, New Relic is how enterprises outsmart complexity to get more from their technology by taking enterprise monitoring to the next level.
- [Media and entertainment observability and monitoring](https://newrelic.com/solutions/industry/digital-media-monitoring): Deliver flawless streaming experiences. Monitor video quality, ad performance, and infrastructure with AI-based observability for media companies.
- [Solutions - HIPAA Compliant Healthcare Observability](https://newrelic.com/solutions/industry/healthcare): New Relic for healthcare | The only HIPAA-enabled observability platform for metrics, events, logs, and traces.
- [Retail and e-commerce monitoring](https://newrelic.com/solutions/industry/retail-and-ecommerce-monitoring): Predict issues before they impact revenue. Monitor every touchpoint from mobile apps to checkout with AI-powered observability for retail.
- [How to go from reactive to responsive](https://newrelic.com/practices/reactive-to-responsive): Continuously improve alert quality with incident response optimization to  deliver actionable alerts that ensure rapid incident resolution, and maximum uptime. 
- [Open Source Observability](https://newrelic.com/solutions/open-source): Instrument once. Visualize everything, Discover New Relic’s Open-Source Observability stack powered by OpenTelemetry and open standards.
- [IT Tool Consolidation](https://newrelic.com/solutions/tool-consolidation): Simplify your DevOps with New Relic's tool consolidation. Reduce complexity, improve team collaboration, and get full-stack visibility in a single, unified platform.
- [Partners - AWS Monitoring](https://newrelic.com/partners/aws-monitoring): Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize your AWS services, apps, and infrastructure for a successful cloud adoption journey.
- [Partners - Google Cloud Platform Observability](https://newrelic.com/partners/gcp): Visibility across infrastructure, applications and digital customer experiences on Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
- [Instant Kubernetes Observability with Pixie](https://newrelic.com/platform/kubernetes-pixie): Make the complex simple with instant, no-code Kubernetes monitoring from New Relic. Easily monitor your Kubernetes clusters and workloads to minimize incidents.
- [New Relic for Azure Monitoring](https://newrelic.com/solutions/partners/azure): Monitor your Azure services and applications, and we can store your telemetry in Azure, too. Find New Relic on the Azure Marketplace for faster onboarding.
- [Partners - Pivotal](https://newrelic.com/solutions/partners/pivotal): Have a complete view of your Pivotal Cloud Foundry (PCF) environment, speed up deployments, and get more value from your cloud native initiative.
- [Prometheus Monitoring | Telemetry Data in One Place](https://newrelic.com/solutions/prometheus-monitoring): New Relic helps you store, manage, and analyze Prometheus metrics to easily monitor your Kubernetes clusters and services running in them. 
- [New Relic Monitoring for SAP® Solutions](https://newrelic.com/solutions/sap): New Relic Monitoring for SAP Solutions gives you a centralized view of SAP and non-SAP systems for infrastructure, application and business processes.
- [New Relic for ServiceNow](https://newrelic.com/solutions/servicenow): New Relic for ServiceNow brings observability insights into workstreams, helps you resolve tickets faster with agentic AI, and automate business-impact analysis.
- [New Relic for Nonprofits](https://newrelic.com/social-impact/signup): Get powerful tech without the high cost. New Relic for nonprofits provides free and discounted access to help mission-driven organizations optimize performance and maximize impact.
- [Solutions - Public Sector IT](https://newrelic.com/solutions/industry/public-sector): New Relic delivers the deep visibility stakeholders need for insights into their most critical workloads, all backed by the highest security standards.
- [Retail and e-commerce monitoring](https://newrelic.com/solutions/industry/retail-and-ecommerce-monitoring): Predict issues before they impact revenue. Monitor every touchpoint from mobile apps to checkout with AI-powered observability for retail.
- [New Relic for Startups](https://newrelic.com/solutions/industry/startups): New Relic for Startups: free platform access, every AI feature, and the engineers who help you launch and scale. A partnership, not just credits.
## Enterprise

- [Enterprise Observability](https://newrelic.com/solutions/enterprise-monitoring): AI-driven for speed and power, New Relic is how enterprises outsmart complexity to get more from their technology by taking enterprise monitoring to the next level.
## Integrations

- [Instant Observability](https://newrelic.com/instant-observability): Instant Observability - Dashboards, alerts, and integrations all in one place! Our quickstarts bundle everything you need to start monitoring like a pro right out of the box.

## About Us

- [About](https://newrelic.com/about): Find out why New Relic is the leader in observability with the only unified data platform for all events, metrics, logs and traces. Try it for free.
